user.title: Göttingen waste calendar (GEB)
user.description: Open https://www.geb-goettingen.de/abfuhr/, select your street and house number, and copy the calendar's subscribe/export link (ICS or webcal://) here. If the site only offers a file download, upload the .ics file somewhere with a publicly reachable URL (e.g. a Nextcloud share or GitHub Gist) and enter that URL instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load the calendar. Check the URL and your internet connection.
error.timeout: Timed out while fetching the calendar.
error.no_events: No events were found at that URL. Make sure it's the correct export link.

abort.already_configured: This calendar URL is already configured.
